description: Reads a saved plan: title, Event details, participants with their all-day and exact-time availability and RSVP answers, best dates and shared free-time windows, suggested places with votes, and the currency. Use when the user shares a plan link or asks about a plan's current state. time_zone resolves today's date; since returns changes after an earlier server_time.

include_all_dates.description: For calendar UI: return all dates within the existing bounded read budget, instead of the concise first 60 per person.

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character plan ID. Links without a plan ID (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/when) are unsaved local drafts and are not accepted.

since.description: Optional ISO timestamp (server_time from an earlier get_plan).

time_zone.description: The user's IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Prague.

name: get_plan
title: Read a plan
